items.observation: Case-A observed completed records with start-style after text and unknown result/validation revisions. A separate public synthetic reproduction on RC15 candidate 42a72ff reproduced rejection of evolved completion metadata in both reporting modes, while unchanged start metadata could complete. Field causation remains unknown. Case-B also self-reports stale outcome metadata; its source records were not independently audited.
evidence: Case-B owner-supplied retrospective attachment, read as unverified self-report; private source retained by owner
tests/test_completion_outcomes.py: 18/18 source lifecycle regressions; full final Windows Python 3.12 suite:136/136 passed
RC16 fix preserves tool-owned start_change, honest unknowns and reporting-mode/crash/retry identity guards; engineering resolution only
items.consequence: Completion labels can retain intended rather than actual results, weakening traceability. Unknown is legitimate and must not become a universal completion prohibition.
items.proposed_improvement: Implemented and engineering-verified in RC16. Original start facts stay immutable; observed outcome fields evolve; completed retry payloads remain immutable. Retrospective field causation and historical activation remain unknown.

items.observation: Case-A reports a handoff saying an earlier test was running while execution evidence contained its result and later rounds. Sampling was non-atomic, so drift duration is unknown. Recorded broad 552/623 and focused 144/145 results have different potentially overlapping scopes. Case-B also reports repeated correction of stale summaries, without independent audit here.
evidence: tests/test_validation_continuity.py:13/13 source regressions; optional SHA-256-bound validation_ref and scoped validation_runs; full final suite:136/136 passed
items.consequence: Receivers can choose stale validation or mistake a focused result for project-wide acceptance; 28 recorded rounds are not 28 independent test sets.
items.proposed_improvement: Implemented as an optional engineering contract in RC16: resolve one bounded canonical structured run, reject stale or unsafe references, show tested state and pending retest, preserve referenced evidence during compaction and legacy state support. This does not prove field adoption or actual test execution. Existing export does not snapshot external referenced files.

items.observation: Case-B reports 60 conversation rounds and 134 commits including feature/pin pairs, while an opted-in ledger contains only 2 prior reports and no upgrade report. Latest/previous checkpoints reportedly remain old and an active result is unknown. No independent invocation history was supplied, so absence of a finish receipt cannot prove the helper was never called.
evidence: Case-B owner-supplied retrospective attachment (unverified aggregate state and invocation claims)
items.consequence: Project activity can outpace bounded lifecycle records. Conversation turns and commit counts do not determine independent task boundaries or justify completing unfinished umbrella work.
items.proposed_improvement: Use begin/finish for deliberately scoped completed work and existing opt-in reporting semantics; retain unfinished umbrella work as active or partial/blocked. Encourage task-scoped stage checkpoints using existing lifecycle, without automatic finish on every pin, a new mandatory history database, historical backfill, or private-project mutation. Validate prospectively.

items.observation: Case-A reports discoverable RC15 and matching 16/16 installed manifest entries, but neither case supplies independent per-round host activation receipts. Case-B reports no observed integrity/state-helper runs; this does not establish that those commands never ran.
evidence: Case-B owner-supplied retrospective attachment (missing execution evidence)
items.consequence: Installation, helper availability, state persistence, historical activation and independent provenance are different claims. Skill-authored activation declarations cannot independently attest loading.
items.proposed_improvement: Preserve historical activation as unknown. When the host supports it and auditing is needed, accept minimal optional sanitized independent activation receipts; do not fabricate receipts or make unsupported host attestation a universal gate. Verify the generated candidate separately from any global installed upgrade.

items.observation: Both cases describe behavior aligned with UPG aims but lack paired baseline/attention-control/UPG outcomes and comparable cost data. Case-B self-reports 65 existing evidence paths, test count 130 to 527, 6 corrections and 2 passing gates; these do not prove causal benefit or absence of regressions. Case-A's 19 numbered constraints do not alone measure overhead.
evidence: Case-B owner-supplied retrospective attachment (counts unverified here)
items.consequence: Net efficiency, reliability, cross-Agent handoff benefit and generalization remain unknown. Increasing rules or test counts cannot close causal evidence gaps.
items.proposed_improvement: Run fresh paired A0/A1/A2 diagnostics, then the unchanged locked protocol when prerequisites exist. Record actual token/time/tool and maintenance costs, failed/overlapping rounds, task success, severe failures, cleanup and scope overreach. Add two-Agent handoff and three-Agent continuation diagnostics without treating them as locked qualification or Stable evidence. No such trial was executed for this disposition.

items.observation: Case-B recommends finishing an entire upgrade and promoting to Stable, while the same retrospective describes remaining implementation and acceptance work plus missing authorization/budget. Its claim that authorization is the sole blocker is not supported by those concurrent unfinished items.
evidence: Case-B owner-supplied retrospective attachment (recommendations evaluated, not executed)
items.consequence: Following the suggestion mechanically risks false completion and conflating permission with engineering acceptance. A final revision alone does not establish validated completed scope.
items.proposed_improvement: Keep RC16 a release candidate. Record authorization, unfinished engineering and unresolved validation as distinct blockers. Never mark an unfinished umbrella workflow complete to repair its ledger; keep partial/blocked work active and report completed bounded work separately. No source-project authorization, deployment, historical completion or Stable promotion is performed.

items.observation: Case-B requests deriving occurrence times from commit dates and mapping contextual signals to validation status. Source times are often unknown. Commit timestamps record commits, while contextual signals are not automatically executable acceptance criteria.
items.consequence: Blind mappings or backfilled timestamps can fabricate chronology and acceptance. Publishing raw source metadata would expose private project identifiers.
items.proposed_improvement: Retain unknown historical facts. Use current observation time only as recording time, source-specific timestamps only with their actual meaning, and explicit validation references for acceptance outcomes. Publish sanitized aggregates with provenance and limits; omit source-event timestamps, private paths/revisions, identities, workflow identifiers, source snippets and raw logs.
